newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss probe insider trading in Biber.
newsitem.headline: Swiss probe insider trading in Biber.

text.p: Swiss prosecutors said they were investigating potential insider trading in Biber Holding AG securities before the firm declared itself insolvent in January.

"I can confirm a criminal investigation is under way, but speculation on where the possible insider sits -- whether in the banks or outside the banks or whether there is one at all -- that is just speculation and I cannot say anything about it," Christian Weber, a Zurich district attorney in charge of white-collar crime, told Reuters.
He was referring to Swiss media reports suggesting big banks with seats on Biber's board may have improperly exploited information about the paper company's financial condition.
